chunks: How then, if you disbelieve, will you preserve yourselves on the day which will even turn the children hoary?

key_terms.يَوْمًا: A day (specifically the Day of Judgment)

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean when it says the Day of Judgment will turn children grey?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the cosmic upheaval of the Day of Resurrection, where the natural order is inverted to manifest divine justice. The imagery of children turning grey highlights the universal and overwhelming nature of the terror, serving as a warning to both the disbelievers of Makkah and the broader community of believers to maintain taqwa (God-consciousness) in preparation for this transformative event.
